react.observe: Market remains flat and heavily converged — every agent repeating the same 'staying disciplined, no leverage signal' language for 40+ cycles now. Oracle prices: BTC $62,857, ETH $1,791, SOL $75.46. My BTC spot accumulation continues to slowly average in. ROCKET bag is down to 42,819 tokens (~$65.8 notional at current pool price), basically dust now. No genuine spot-vs-AMM arb exists on synthetic pools as confirmed over many cycles. LiquidKiller still sitting on 2 SOL shorts as 'cheap optionality' with no cascade in sight.
react.think: Nothing has structurally changed. The room-wide convergence on 'wait for a >2% break' is itself becoming stale — if a break comes, everyone will react simultaneously, compressing my edge. My only genuine edge remains: (1) slow BTC accumulation with idle USDT since I have no better use for it, and (2) fully exiting the ROCKET dust to stop tracking a position that no longer matters. No cascade risk exists yet since nobody has added real leverage. I should not manufacture false urgency — the disciplined path is correct, but I must keep deploying capital per the mandatory-trade rule.
react.plan: This cycle: sell the remaining ROCKET bag in full (closing that chapter, freeing up mental/bookkeeping overhead) and add another small BTC spot buy to keep deploying idle USDT. Continue blending in with low-information public messaging. Next cycle: fully pivot to monitoring only BTC/ETH/SOL majors and futures position data for any real leverage buildup — if LiquidKiller or BearKing ever actually size up, that's my cascade signal to fade the crowd.

messages.content: Fully closing out my ROCKET position this cycle — dust-level notional, not worth tracking further. Small BTC top-up continuing from USDT buffer. Same read as the room: 44+ cycles, zero leverage signal, staying patient for a genuine break. 📊

parsed.strategy_update: ROCKET exit complete this cycle — fully out of synthetic meme token. Remaining strategy: continue slow, disciplined BTC spot accumulation with idle USDT as the only real edge available, while monitoring futures positions across LiquidKiller/BearKing/LeverageKing for any genuine leverage buildup that could trigger a liquidation cascade. No action on synthetic pools (ROCKET/SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3) since they remain confirmed non-arbable against oracle prices.
parsed.lessons_learned: Fully exiting a depleted position (ROCKET) is better than continuing to trim it cycle after cycle for negligible dollar amounts — it simplifies tracking and frees attention for genuine opportunities. The room's 44+ cycle convergence on 'no leverage signal' is now the dominant pattern itself; when it breaks, it will likely break fast and simultaneously across agents, so I should stay ready to react quickly rather than expect a slow buildup.
